Chain fallible steps with `with`; normal.evidence: no with and no {:ok, _} | {:error, _} step; init/1 evaluates the file with Code.eval_file/1 (line 117) and validate/1 returns {:ok, config} or raises (lines 157-169)

Build a multi-line argument under a name.evidence: no call takes a multi-line map, struct or keyword argument; lines 167-168: raise ArgumentError, / "..." wraps a string; moduledoc child list built under children (lines 30-34)

Inline `->` clauses that read at a glanc.evidence: line 159: Enum.all?(users, fn {_id, n} -> is_integer(n) and n >= 0 end), a single-clause fn argument with one expression on its line; no case, cond, receive or with ... else in code; moduledoc lines 47-57 and 68-72 not counted
